# Spec field reference

Every field in gtm.yaml, positioning.yaml, personas.yaml, messaging.yaml, topics.yaml and competitors.yaml: type, default and meaning.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-docs.mjs from `gtm reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every field of the GTM spec, generated from the schema that `gtm validate` enforces in version 2.0.0.

The same schemas ship as JSON Schema files in the package, under `schemas/`, so an editor with YAML language support validates as you type.

## gtm.yaml

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | 2 | yes |  | Spec format version. Always 2. |
| `site` | object | yes |  |  |
| `site.name` | string | yes |  | The name people and machines should use for this site, product or person. |
| `site.url` | string | yes |  | Canonical origin. Every generated URL is built on it. |
| `site.description` | string | yes |  | One or two sentences. Used in llms.txt, structured data and GTM.md. |
| `site.language` | string |  | `"en"` | BCP 47 language tag. |
| `owner` | object |  |  |  |
| `owner.type` | "person" or "organization" | yes |  | Drives the schema.org type in structured data. |
| `owner.name` | string | yes |  | The person or organization behind the site. |
| `owner.url` | string |  |  | Their canonical page. Defaults to site.url. |
| `owner.jobTitle` | string |  |  | For a person. |
| `owner.description` | string |  |  | One or two sentences about them. |
| `owner.sameAs` | list of string |  |  | Profiles that are the same entity: LinkedIn, GitHub, X. |
| `content` | object |  |  |  |
| `content.publicDir` | string |  | `"public"` | Where static assets live. Used to resolve links to files. |
| `content.collections` | map |  |  | Folders of markdown that become pages, keyed by a name you choose. |
| `content.collections.<name>.path` | string | yes |  | Directory that holds the files, relative to the project root. |
| `content.collections.<name>.include` | string |  | `"**/*.{md,mdx}"` | Glob, relative to path. |
| `content.collections.<name>.url` | string | yes |  | URL pattern, for example "/blog/{slug}". An index file maps to its folder. |
| `content.collections.<name>.type` | "article" or "doc" or "page" |  | `"article"` | Articles are dated; docs and pages are not. |
| `content.collections.<name>.label` | string |  |  | Section heading in llms.txt. Defaults to the collection key. |
| `content.collections.<name>.sitemap` | boolean |  | `true` | List these pages in sitemap.xml. |
| `content.collections.<name>.llms` | boolean |  | `true` | List these pages in llms.txt. |
| `content.collections.<name>.lint` | boolean |  | `true` | Run `gtm lint` on these files. |
| `content.routes` | list of string or object |  |  | Pages that are not backed by a markdown file. |
| `crawlers` | object |  |  |  |
| `crawlers.disallow` | list of string |  |  | Paths no crawler may fetch. |
| `crawlers.ai` | object |  |  |  |
| `crawlers.ai.training` | "allow" or "disallow" |  | `"allow"` | Crawlers that collect data to train models. |
| `crawlers.ai.search` | "allow" or "disallow" |  | `"allow"` | Crawlers that build AI search indexes. |
| `crawlers.ai.user` | "allow" or "disallow" |  | `"allow"` | Fetchers acting for a person inside an assistant. |
| `crawlers.agents` | map |  |  | Per user-agent override, for example { Bytespider: disallow }. |
| `outputs` | object |  |  |  |
| `outputs.robots` | string or false |  | `"public/robots.txt"` | Where to write robots.txt, or false to skip it. |
| `outputs.sitemap` | string or false |  | `"public/sitemap.xml"` | Where to write sitemap.xml, or false to skip it. |
| `outputs.llms` | string or false |  | `"public/llms.txt"` | Where to write llms.txt, or false to skip it. |
| `outputs.context` | string or false |  | `"GTM.md"` | The brief for coding agents and new teammates. |
| `outputs.schema` | string or false |  | `false` | schema.org JSON-LD graph as a JSON file. |
| `lint` | object |  |  |  |
| `lint.rules` | map |  |  | Rule id to "error", "warn", "off" or [severity, options]. |
| `lint.ignore` | list of string |  |  | Globs of content files to skip. |
| `lint.overrides` | list of object |  |  | Different settings for some files. Later entries win. |
| `lint.overrides[].files` | list of string | yes |  |  |
| `lint.overrides[].rules` | map | yes |  |  |

## positioning.yaml

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | string | yes |  | The market category you want to be filed under. |
| `oneLiner` | string | yes |  | What it is and who it is for, in one sentence. |
| `tagline` | string |  |  | A short line for headers and social cards. |
| `problem` | string | yes |  | The problem, in the words of the people who have it. |
| `audience` | list of string |  |  | Persona ids, most important first. |
| `differentiators` | list of object |  |  | Why you, and not the alternative. |
| `differentiators[].id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `differentiators[].claim` | string | yes |  | The difference, stated plainly. |
| `differentiators[].proof` | list of string |  |  | Evidence: a number, a link, a named customer, a commit. |
| `notThis` | list of string |  |  | What you are not. Disambiguation that people and language models both need. |

## personas.yaml

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[].id` | string | yes |  | Stable id. Content refers to it with `persona:` in frontmatter. |
| `[].name` | string | yes |  | What the team calls this reader. |
| `[].role` | string |  |  | Job title or situation. |
| `[].description` | string |  |  | A sentence or two of context. |
| `[].jobs` | list of string |  |  | Jobs to be done. |
| `[].pains` | list of string |  |  | What makes those jobs hard today. |
| `[].triggers` | list of string |  |  | Events that make them look for a solution. |
| `[].questions` | list of string |  |  | Questions they type into search or ask an assistant. Each one is a content brief. |

## messaging.yaml

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pillars` | list of object |  |  |  |
| `pillars[].id` | string | yes |  | Stable id. Content refers to it with `pillar:` in frontmatter. |
| `pillars[].title` | string | yes |  | The pillar as a headline. |
| `pillars[].claim` | string | yes |  | The argument, in a sentence or two. |
| `pillars[].proof` | list of string |  |  | Evidence: a number, a link, a named customer, a commit. |
| `pillars[].personas` | list of string |  |  | Persona ids this pillar speaks to. |
| `boilerplate` | object |  |  |  |
| `boilerplate.short` | string |  |  | Up to 160 characters. Meta descriptions and bios. |
| `boilerplate.medium` | string |  |  | A paragraph. About sections and press. |
| `vocabulary` | object |  |  |  |
| `vocabulary.prefer` | list of object |  |  |  |
| `vocabulary.prefer[].term` | string | yes |  | The spelling you own. |
| `vocabulary.prefer[].insteadOf` | list of string | yes |  | Variants `gtm lint` should flag. |
| `vocabulary.prefer[].reason` | string |  |  | Shown next to the finding. |
| `vocabulary.avoid` | list of object |  |  |  |
| `vocabulary.avoid[].term` | string | yes |  | A word or phrase, matched case-insensitively on word boundaries. |
| `vocabulary.avoid[].reason` | string |  |  | Shown next to the finding. |
| `voice` | list of string |  |  | Plain-language writing guidance. Compiled into GTM.md. |

## topics.yaml

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[].id` | string | yes |  | Stable id. Content refers to it with `topic:` in frontmatter. |
| `[].name` | string | yes |  | The topic as readers would name it. |
| `[].description` | string |  |  | What the topic covers. |
| `[].pillar` | string |  |  | The messaging pillar this topic supports. |
| `[].personas` | list of string |  |  | Persona ids who care about it. |
| `[].keywords` | list of string |  |  | Phrases a piece on this topic is expected to use. |
| `[].questions` | list of string |  |  | Questions the topic should answer. Counted by `gtm coverage`. |

## competitors.yaml

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[].id` | string | yes |  | Stable id. |
| `[].name` | string | yes |  | The alternative, by name. |
| `[].url` | string |  |  | Their site. |
| `[].kind` | "direct" or "adjacent" or "status-quo" |  | `"direct"` | direct: same job, same buyer. adjacent: overlapping job. status-quo: what people do without a product. |
| `[].summary` | string | yes |  | What they are, stated fairly. |
| `[].weDiffer` | string | yes |  | The honest difference. This is what agents will repeat. |
